agent_explanation: The state-feedback controller prioritizes keeping pole angle small (margin ~0.72 rad at violation) and applies only ~0.8 N despite 65 N limit. With initial x=0.436 and v~0.3 outward, cart drifts monotonically and accumulates velocity ~1.37 m/s, exiting |x|<=2.4 at step 261. The shrunk scenario has no pushes or noise, so failure is purely due to insufficient cart-position regulation / zero steady-state correction, allowing position drift while pole remains balanced.
